fusions.name: Barbed Reach
fusions.desc: Snags a target up to 7 tiles away and rushes you to it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Catch Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a barbed spear that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Haul In
fusions.desc: Drags every enemy near a point of force ahead of you inward for 6 seconds. The wall is 6 tiles long.

fusions.name: Snagging Strands
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a barbed line snags the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
